# SupplementScore

> Who runs SupplementScore, how scores and evidence tiers are calculated, and how the site is funded. No ads, sponsors, or affiliate links.

## Start here

- [About](https://supplementscore.org/about.html): Who runs SupplementScore, how scores and evidence tiers are calculated, and how the site is funded. No ads, sponsors, or affiliate links.
- [Methodology](https://supplementscore.org/about.html#methodology): How scores and evidence tiers are calculated.
- [Browse](https://supplementscore.org/browse.html): Browse 200+ top-rated supplements by composite evidence score. Full database has 780+ supplements, ranked on real trial evidence, not marketing.
- [Open data](https://supplementscore.org/data/): Download the SupplementScore database as JSON or CSV. Supplements, drug interactions, pairings, brand notes. CC-BY 4.0, no API key required.
